# Mittlere Frist

- Wir tragen in diesem Abschnitt die Lösungen aus dem Abschnitt [Die Mikroökonomik der Makroökonomik](https://janvoss.github.io/Makro/Mikromakro.html) zusammen und analysieren das makroökonomische Gleichgewicht

- Dabei gehen wir davon aus, dass alle Märkte/Preise beliebig flexibel sind, sodass sich immer Gleichgewichtspreise (und entsprechende -mengen) bilden können.

- Geld beeinflusst in diesem Modell das Gleichgewicht nicht. Wir zeigen zunächst das Gleichgewicht ohne Geld (@sec-Neoklassik_ohne_Geld) und dann mit Geld (@sec-Neoklassik_mit_Geld)

## Reales neoklassisches Grundmodell (ohne Geld) {#sec-Neoklassik_ohne_Geld}

### Einleitung

- Entscheidungen wie in @sec-Mikromakro

- Flexible Märkte

- Analyse der Gleichgewichte, nicht der Gleichgewichtsbildung

- Darstellung hier: Allgemeine Form der Gleichung und Spezifikation zur Veanschaulichung

### Haushalt

#### Einkommensverwendung

$$C_t = C^d(Y_t - T_t, Y_{t+1} - T_{t+1}, r_t)$$

Für CRRA-Nutzenfunktion:

$$C_t(r, W) = \frac{W}{1 + \beta^{\frac{1}{\sigma}} (1+r)^{\frac{1-\sigma}{\sigma}}}$$

Mit $W=Y_t-G_t+ \frac{Y_{t+1}-G_{t+1}}{1+r}$


#### Arbeisangebot

$$N_t = N^s(w_t, \theta_t)$$

Für hier angenommene Nutzenfunktion $$\theta_t \frac{1}{1 - N_t} = w_t$$ bzw. 

$$N^S_t = 1 - \frac{\theta_t}{w_t}$$
(Entscheidung über $N_{t+1}$ analog)

### Unternehmen

#### Produktion

$$Y_t=A_t F(K_t, N_t)$$

Spezifikation hier: 

$$\begin{align*}
Y_t &= A_t K_t^{\alpha} N_t^{1-\alpha}, \quad 0 < \alpha < 1 \\
Y_{t+1} &= A_{t+1} K_{t+1}^{\alpha} N_{t+1}^{1-\alpha}
\end{align*}$$

#### Investition

Entwicklung des Kapitalstocks

$$K_{t+1}=I_t+(1-\delta)K_t$$

$$I_t=I_t^d(r_t, A_{t+1}, K_t)$$

Spezifikation hier: 


$$I_t = N_{t+1} \left(\frac{\alpha A_{t+1}}{r_t + \delta}\right)^{\frac{1}{1 - \alpha}} - (1 - \delta) K_t$$

::: {.callout-note icon="false" collapse="true"}
## Umstellen der Investitionsfunktion {.unnumbered}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\alpha A_{t+1} \left(\frac{N_{t+1}}{I_t + (1 - \delta) K_t}\right)^{1 - \alpha} &= r_t + \delta \\
\left(\frac{N_{t+1}}{I_t + (1 - \delta) K_t}\right)^{1 - \alpha} &= \frac{r_t + \delta}{\alpha A_{t+1}} \\
\frac{N_{t+1}}{I_t + (1 - \delta) K_t} &= \left(\frac{r_t + \delta}{\alpha A_{t+1}}\right)^{\frac{1}{1 - \alpha}} \\
I_t + (1 - \delta) K_t &= N_{t+1} \left(\frac{\alpha A_{t+1}}{r_t + \delta}\right)^{\frac{1}{1 - \alpha}} \\
I_t &= N_{t+1} \left(\frac{\alpha A_{t+1}}{r_t + \delta}\right)^{\frac{1}{1 - \alpha}} - (1 - \delta) K_t
\end{aligned}
$$

:::

#### Arbeitsnachfrage

$$N_t=N^d(w_t, A_t, K_t)$$

Spezifikation hier: $$(1 - \alpha) A_t \left(\frac{K_t}{N_t}\right)^{\alpha} = w_t$$


bzw.

$$N^D_t = K_t \left(\frac{(1 - \alpha) A_t}{w_t}\right)^{\frac{1}{\alpha}}$$

::: {.callout-note icon="false" collapse="true"}
## Umstellen der Arbeitsnachfragefunktion {.unnumbered}

$$
\begin{aligned}
(1 - \alpha) A_t \left(\frac{K_t}{N_t}\right)^{\alpha} &= w_t \\
\left(\frac{K_t}{N_t}\right)^{\alpha} &= \frac{w_t}{(1 - \alpha) A_t} \\
\frac{K_t}{N_t} &= \left(\frac{w_t}{(1 - \alpha) A_t}\right)^{\frac{1}{\alpha}} \\
N^d_t &= K_t \left(\frac{(1 - \alpha) A_t}{w_t}\right)^{\frac{1}{\alpha}}
\end{aligned}
$$
:::

### Regierung

$$G_t + \frac{G_{t+1}}{1 + r_t} = T_t + \frac{T_{t+1}}{1 + r_t}$$

$$C_t + \frac{C_{t+1}}{1 + r_t} = Y_t - G_t + \frac{Y_{t+1} - G_{t+1}}{1 + r_t}$$

Ricardianische Äquivalenz: Das Timing der Steuereinnahmen ist für das Gleichgewicht irrelevant.

### Produktivitätsschock heute

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: "Produktivitätsschock heute"

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. ZENTRALE PARAMETERDEFINITION (Single Source of Truth)
# ==============================================================================
BASE_PARAMS <- list(
  K_t      = 10.0,
  delta    = 0.10,
  theta_t  = 1.40,
  theta_t1 = 1.20,
  G_t      = 0.50,
  G_t1     = 0.50,
  sigma    = 1.00,
  beta     = 0.96,
  A_t      = 6.00,
  A_t1     = 8.00,
  alpha    = 0.33
)

SHOCK_PARAMS <- modifyList(BASE_PARAMS, list(A_t = 8.00))

# ==============================================================================
# 2. MODELL-SOLVER
# ==============================================================================
solve_macro_model <- function(p) {
  with(p, {
    labor_eq_t <- function(w) {
      Nd <- K_t * ((1 - alpha) * A_t / w)^(1 / alpha)
      Ns <- 1 - theta_t / w
      return(Nd - Ns)
    }
    w_t <- uniroot(labor_eq_t, interval = c(theta_t + 1e-6, 1000))$root
    N_t <- 1 - theta_t / w_t
    Y_t <- A_t * K_t^alpha * N_t^(1 - alpha)
    D_t <- Y_t - w_t * N_t

    eval_given_r <- function(r, Y_hyp = Y_t) {
      k_n_ratio <- (alpha * A_t1 / (r + delta))^(1 / (1 - alpha))
      w_t1 <- (1 - alpha) * A_t1 * (k_n_ratio)^alpha
      N_t1 <- 1 - theta_t1 / w_t1
      if (is.na(N_t1) || N_t1 <= 0 || is.na(k_n_ratio) || k_n_ratio <= 0) {
        return(list(
          excess_demand = NA, I_t = NA, Y_IS = NA, Yd = NA,
          Y_t1 = NA, N_t1 = NA, K_t1 = NA, w_t1 = NA, D_t1 = NA
        ))
      }

      K_t1 <- k_n_ratio * N_t1
      I_t  <- K_t1 - (1 - delta) * K_t
      B_I  <- I_t
      Y_t1 <- A_t1 * K_t1^alpha * N_t1^(1 - alpha)
      D_t1 <- Y_t1 + (1 - delta) * K_t1 - w_t1 * N_t1 - (1 + r) * B_I

      PV_t1 <- (w_t1 * N_t1 + D_t1 - G_t1) / (1 + r)
      W     <- (Y_hyp - G_t) + PV_t1
      mpc   <- 1 / (1 + beta^(1 / sigma) * (1 + r)^((1 - sigma) / sigma))
      C_t   <- mpc * W

      Yd <- C_t + I_t + G_t
      excess_demand <- Yd - Y_hyp

      denom <- 1 - mpc
      Y_IS <- if (abs(denom) > 1e-8) (mpc * (PV_t1 - G_t) + I_t + G_t) / denom else NA

      S_t  <- Y_hyp - G_t - C_t
      C_t1 <- (1 + r) * S_t + w_t1 * N_t1 + D_t1 - G_t1

      list(
        r_t = r, w_t = w_t, N_t = N_t, Y_t = Y_t, D_t = D_t,
        C_t = C_t, I_t = I_t, S_t = S_t, G_t = G_t, Yd = Yd, Y_IS = Y_IS,
        w_t1 = w_t1, N_t1 = N_t1, K_t1 = K_t1, Y_t1 = Y_t1,
        D_t1 = D_t1, C_t1 = C_t1, G_t1 = G_t1, W = W, PV_t1 = PV_t1,
        excess_demand = excess_demand,
        check_t1 = Y_t1 + (1 - delta) * K_t1 - (C_t1 + G_t1)
      )
    }

    r_max <- alpha * A_t1 * ((1 - alpha) * A_t1 / theta_t1)^((1 - alpha) / alpha) - delta
    r_min <- max(-delta + 1e-5, -0.99)
    r_star <- uniroot(
      function(r) eval_given_r(r, Y_hyp = Y_t)$excess_demand,
      interval = c(r_min, r_max - 1e-6)
    )$root

    out <- eval_given_r(r_star, Y_hyp = Y_t)
    out$eval_given_r <- eval_given_r
    out$r_max <- r_max
    out$params <- p
    return(out)
  })
}

eq0 <- solve_macro_model(BASE_PARAMS)
eq1 <- solve_macro_model(SHOCK_PARAMS)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. STATISCHE GGPLOT2 + PATCHWORK GRAFIK
# ==============================================================================
theme_macro <- theme_light(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 4, b = 0, l = 4),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5)
  )

# Gemeinsame x-Achse für die linke Spalte (N_t)
n_limits <- c(0, 1.0)
n_breaks <- seq(0, 1.0, by = 0.2)

# Gemeinsame x-Achse für die rechte Spalte (Y_t)
Y_eq0 <- eq0$Y_t
Y_eq1 <- eq1$Y_t
Y_temp <- eq1$eval_given_r(eq0$r_t, Y_hyp = Y_eq1)$Y_IS

r_min_common <- max(-min(BASE_PARAMS$delta, SHOCK_PARAMS$delta) + 0.01, -0.05)
r_max_common <- min(eq0$r_max, eq1$r_max) * 0.70
r_low  <- max(r_min_common, min(eq0$r_t, eq1$r_t) - 0.08)
r_high <- min(r_max_common, max(eq0$r_t, eq1$r_t) + 0.08)
r_grid_is <- seq(r_low, r_high, length.out = 220)

Y_is0 <- sapply(r_grid_is, function(r) eq0$eval_given_r(r)$Y_IS)
```

### Produktivitätsschock morgen

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: "Produktivitätsschock morgen"

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. ZENTRALE PARAMETERDEFINITION (Single Source of Truth)
# ==============================================================================
BASE_PARAMS <- list(
  K_t      = 10.0,
  delta    = 0.10,
  theta_t  = 1.40,
  theta_t1 = 1.20,
  G_t      = 0.50,
  G_t1     = 0.50,
  sigma    = 1.00,
  beta     = 0.96,
  A_t      = 6.00,
  A_t1     = 8.00,
  alpha    = 0.33
)

# Schock: Anstieg der künftigen Produktivität A_{t+1} ausgehend von der Baseline
SHOCK_PARAMS <- modifyList(BASE_PARAMS, list(A_t1 = 10.00))

# ==============================================================================
# 2. MODELL-SOLVER
# ==============================================================================
solve_macro_model <- function(p) {
  with(p, {
    labor_eq_t <- function(w) {
      Nd <- K_t * ((1 - alpha) * A_t / w)^(1 / alpha)
      Ns <- 1 - theta_t / w
      return(Nd - Ns)
    }
    w_t <- uniroot(labor_eq_t, interval = c(theta_t + 1e-6, 1000))$root
    N_t <- 1 - theta_t / w_t
    Y_t <- A_t * K_t^alpha * N_t^(1 - alpha)
    D_t <- Y_t - w_t * N_t

    eval_given_r <- function(r, Y_hyp = Y_t) {
      k_n_ratio <- (alpha * A_t1 / (r + delta))^(1 / (1 - alpha))
      w_t1 <- (1 - alpha) * A_t1 * (k_n_ratio)^alpha
      N_t1 <- 1 - theta_t1 / w_t1
      if (is.na(N_t1) || N_t1 <= 0 || is.na(k_n_ratio) || k_n_ratio <= 0) {
        return(list(
          excess_demand = NA, I_t = NA, Y_IS = NA, Yd = NA,
          Y_t1 = NA, N_t1 = NA, K_t1 = NA, w_t1 = NA, D_t1 = NA
        ))
      }

      K_t1 <- k_n_ratio * N_t1
      I_t  <- K_t1 - (1 - delta) * K_t
      B_I  <- I_t
      Y_t1 <- A_t1 * K_t1^alpha * N_t1^(1 - alpha)
      D_t1 <- Y_t1 + (1 - delta) * K_t1 - w_t1 * N_t1 - (1 + r) * B_I

      PV_t1 <- (w_t1 * N_t1 + D_t1 - G_t1) / (1 + r)
      W     <- (Y_hyp - G_t) + PV_t1
      mpc   <- 1 / (1 + beta^(1 / sigma) * (1 + r)^((1 - sigma) / sigma))
      C_t   <- mpc * W

      Yd <- C_t + I_t + G_t
      excess_demand <- Yd - Y_hyp

      denom <- 1 - mpc
      Y_IS <- if (abs(denom) > 1e-8) (mpc * (PV_t1 - G_t) + I_t + G_t) / denom else NA

      S_t  <- Y_hyp - G_t - C_t
      C_t1 <- (1 + r) * S_t + w_t1 * N_t1 + D_t1 - G_t1

      list(
        r_t = r, w_t = w_t, N_t = N_t, Y_t = Y_t, D_t = D_t,
        C_t = C_t, I_t = I_t, S_t = S_t, G_t = G_t, Yd = Yd, Y_IS = Y_IS,
        w_t1 = w_t1, N_t1 = N_t1, K_t1 = K_t1, Y_t1 = Y_t1,
        D_t1 = D_t1, C_t1 = C_t1, G_t1 = G_t1, W = W, PV_t1 = PV_t1,
        excess_demand = excess_demand,
        check_t1 = Y_t1 + (1 - delta) * K_t1 - (C_t1 + G_t1)
      )
    }

    r_max <- alpha * A_t1 * ((1 - alpha) * A_t1 / theta_t1)^((1 - alpha) / alpha) - delta
    r_min <- max(-delta + 1e-5, -0.99)
    r_star <- uniroot(
      function(r) eval_given_r(r, Y_hyp = Y_t)$excess_demand,
      interval = c(r_min, r_max - 1e-6)
    )$root

    out <- eval_given_r(r_star, Y_hyp = Y_t)
    out$eval_given_r <- eval_given_r
    out$r_max <- r_max
    out$params <- p
    return(out)
  })
}

eq0 <- solve_macro_model(BASE_PARAMS)
eq1 <- solve_macro_model(SHOCK_PARAMS)

# ==============================================================================
```

### Erhöhung der Staatsausgaben heute

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: "Erhöhung der Staatsausgaben heute"


library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. ZENTRALE PARAMETERDEFINITION (Single Source of Truth)
# ==============================================================================
BASE_PARAMS <- list(
  K_t      = 10.0,
  delta    = 0.10,
  theta_t  = 1.40,
  theta_t1 = 1.20,
  G_t      = 0.50,
  G_t1     = 0.50,
  sigma    = 1.00,
  beta     = 0.96,
  A_t      = 6.00,
  A_t1     = 8.00,
  alpha    = 0.33
)

# Schock: Erhöhung der laufenden Staatsausgaben G_t ausgehend von der Baseline
SHOCK_PARAMS <- modifyList(BASE_PARAMS, list(G_t = 1.50))

# ==============================================================================
# 2. MODELL-SOLVER
# ==============================================================================
solve_macro_model <- function(p) {
  with(p, {
    labor_eq_t <- function(w) {
      Nd <- K_t * ((1 - alpha) * A_t / w)^(1 / alpha)
      Ns <- 1 - theta_t / w
      return(Nd - Ns)
    }
    w_t <- uniroot(labor_eq_t, interval = c(theta_t + 1e-6, 1000))$root
    N_t <- 1 - theta_t / w_t
    Y_t <- A_t * K_t^alpha * N_t^(1 - alpha)
    D_t <- Y_t - w_t * N_t

    eval_given_r <- function(r, Y_hyp = Y_t) {
      k_n_ratio <- (alpha * A_t1 / (r + delta))^(1 / (1 - alpha))
      w_t1 <- (1 - alpha) * A_t1 * (k_n_ratio)^alpha
      N_t1 <- 1 - theta_t1 / w_t1
      if (is.na(N_t1) || N_t1 <= 0 || is.na(k_n_ratio) || k_n_ratio <= 0) {
        return(list(
          excess_demand = NA, I_t = NA, Y_IS = NA, Yd = NA,
          Y_t1 = NA, N_t1 = NA, K_t1 = NA, w_t1 = NA, D_t1 = NA
        ))
      }

      K_t1 <- k_n_ratio * N_t1
      I_t  <- K_t1 - (1 - delta) * K_t
      B_I  <- I_t
      Y_t1 <- A_t1 * K_t1^alpha * N_t1^(1 - alpha)
      D_t1 <- Y_t1 + (1 - delta) * K_t1 - w_t1 * N_t1 - (1 + r) * B_I

      PV_t1 <- (w_t1 * N_t1 + D_t1 - G_t1) / (1 + r)
      W     <- (Y_hyp - G_t) + PV_t1
      mpc   <- 1 / (1 + beta^(1 / sigma) * (1 + r)^((1 - sigma) / sigma))
      C_t   <- mpc * W

      Yd <- C_t + I_t + G_t
      excess_demand <- Yd - Y_hyp

      denom <- 1 - mpc
      Y_IS <- if (abs(denom) > 1e-8) (mpc * (PV_t1 - G_t) + I_t + G_t) / denom else NA

      S_t  <- Y_hyp - G_t - C_t
      C_t1 <- (1 + r) * S_t + w_t1 * N_t1 + D_t1 - G_t1

      list(
        r_t = r, w_t = w_t, N_t = N_t, Y_t = Y_t, D_t = D_t,
        C_t = C_t, I_t = I_t, S_t = S_t, G_t = G_t, Yd = Yd, Y_IS = Y_IS,
        w_t1 = w_t1, N_t1 = N_t1, K_t1 = K_t1, Y_t1 = Y_t1,
        D_t1 = D_t1, C_t1 = C_t1, G_t1 = G_t1, W = W, PV_t1 = PV_t1,
        excess_demand = excess_demand,
        check_t1 = Y_t1 + (1 - delta) * K_t1 - (C_t1 + G_t1)
      )
    }

    r_max <- alpha * A_t1 * ((1 - alpha) * A_t1 / theta_t1)^((1 - alpha) / alpha) - delta
    r_min <- max(-delta + 1e-5, -0.99)
    r_star <- uniroot(
      function(r) eval_given_r(r, Y_hyp = Y_t)$excess_demand,
      interval = c(r_min, r_max - 1e-6)
    )$root

    out <- eval_given_r(r_star, Y_hyp = Y_t)
    out$eval_given_r <- eval_given_r
    out$r_max <- r_max
    out$params <- p
    return(out)
  })
}

eq0 <- solve_macro_model(BASE_PARAMS)
eq1 <- solve_macro_model(SHOCK_PARAMS)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. STATISCHE GGPLOT2 + PATCHWORK GRAFIK

  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

  geom_line(
    data = subset(df_keynes, Kurve == "gg"),
    aes(x = Y, y = Yd, color = "gg"),
    linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.85
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = subset(df_keynes, Kurve == "base"),
    aes(x = Y, y = Yd, color = "base"),
    linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1.0
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = subset(df_keynes, Kurve == "impuls"),
    aes(x = Y, y = Yd),
    color = "grey55", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.85
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = subset(df_keynes, Kurve == "schock"),
    aes(x = Y, y = Yd, color = "schock"),
    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.0
  ) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = Y_eq0, xend = Y_eq0, y = y_min_plot, yend = Y_eq0), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey35") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = y_min_plot, xend = Y_eq0, y = Y_eq0, yend = Y_eq0), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey35") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = Y_eq1, xend = Y_eq1, y = y_min_plot, yend = Y_eq1), linetype = "dotted", color = "#70AD47") +
  geom_point(aes(x = Y_eq0, y = Y_eq0), color = "#2E75B6", size = 2.6) +
  geom_point(aes(x = Y_temp, y = Y_temp), color = "grey55", size = 2.3) +
  geom_point(aes(x = Y_eq1, y = Y_eq1), color = "#70AD47", size = 2.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = y_limits, breaks = y_breaks, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, breaks = y_breaks, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    breaks = keynes_breaks,
    values = c("gg" = "black", "base" = "#2E75B6", "schock" = "#70AD47"),
    labels = keynes_labels
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      override.aes = list(
        color = c("black", "#2E75B6", "#70AD47"),
        linetype = c("solid", "solid", "dashed")
      )
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Güternachfrage (Keynesianisches Kreuz)",
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(Güternachfrage~Y[t]^d)
  ) +
  theme_macro +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

df_is <- rbind(
  data.frame(r = r_grid_is, Y = Y_is0, Kurve = "base"),
  data.frame(r = r_grid_is, Y = Y_is1, Kurve = "shock")
)

p_is <- ggplot(df_is, aes(x = Y, y = r, color = Kurve, linetype = Kurve)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = Y_eq0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.9, linetype = "solid") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = Y_eq1, color = "#70AD47", linewidth = 0.9, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = y_min_plot, xend = Y_eq0, y = eq0$r_t, yend = eq0$r_t), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey35") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = y_min_plot, xend = Y_eq1, y = eq1$r_t, yend = eq1$r_t), linetype = "dotted", color = "#70AD47") +
  geom_point(aes(x = Y_eq0, y = eq0$r_t), color = "black", size = 2.7) +
  geom_point(aes(x = Y_eq1, y = eq1$r_t), color = "#70AD47", size = 2.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = y_limits, breaks = y_breaks, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(r_low, r_high),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("base" = "black", "shock" = "#2E75B6"),
    labels = list(
      "base"  = bquote(IS),
      "shock" = bquote(IS^"'"~(G[t]))
    )
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("base" = "solid", "shock" = "dashed"),
    labels = list(
      "base"  = bquote(IS),
      "shock" = bquote(IS^"'"~(G[t]))
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "IS-Kurve und Güterangebotsgleichgewicht",
    x = expression(Output~"/"~Einkommen~Y[t]),
    y = expression(Realzins~r[t])
  ) +
  theme_macro

# --- GESAMTKOMBINATION MIT PATCHWORK ---
(p_labor / p_prod + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))) |
  (p_keynes / p_is + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)))
```
